realizes.rationale: The mcp/src/agents_remember/package_data/runtime shipped copy propagates the skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/roles/curator.md instructions to that installation surface; it is generated output and does not independently set role/task or permission authority.

1.note: The mirror carries the same effect contract as the canonical role.

10.note: An overview starts with its title, an optional governing overview and its purpose heading, puts a change into the body section that owns its meaning, and ends with all numbered citation lines together.

12.note: Curation keeps reconciliation and memory writing with the Curator and the Git transaction with the Manager; the Curator runs no Git write, closeout preview or landing decision.

13.note: The leaf pass starts only on a leaf task document, never taskless; registered tasks belong to a master, and no standalone leaf, fake task, worktree or enclosure is fabricated for the leaf or foundation route.

14.note: For every card cut by the quality check the Curator names the source evidence that makes the removed text untrue; text is never removed merely to clear a quality finding.

15.note: The Curator also repairs wrong or missing memory it encounters while curating, whoever left it and beyond the quality check's findings, through the writer; it names each repair, makes no broad sweep and routes repairs needing code, a requirement decision or another leaf's work.

2.note: Curation reconciles three bodies of evidence (current intent, ruled change intent and implemented reality) and succeeds when they agree or every material divergence has reached its answering seat.

3.note: The Curator runs no Git write and edits no code, gate, lifecycle state, worktree contract or closeout state; it edits a task document only as its writer under its assignment with the scoped correct-write recovery, and advances no fingerprint to an uncommitted tree.

6.note: On converted memory a role agent that wrote none of the leaf's cards or records checks every changed card, sidecar and record statement by statement before closeout; judgment history belongs in content-bound Curator rows and a counted card edit alone never closes a trace.

7.note:
The Curator writes knowledge with knowledge_write or the admitted serving-build command-line writer with the task contract, handoff list and commit; the commit option authorizes file writes, not Git or acceptance.

Anchor: `knowledge_write`

8.note:
When its part is complete the Curator marks only its own task-document step done through task_doc set_step with a one-line note; an incomplete, blocked or progress report never marks unfinished work done.

Anchor: `task_doc`

9.note: The stage ends when task knowledge is written and checked and quality is clean, distinguishing installed-writer publication from scoped manual provenance; own faulty-input refusals and coherence findings are repaired through the same writer, and open permission prompts, other correct-input refusals, unowned state and requirement-meaning questions stop the work.
